verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a nun with five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Āvāsamaccharinī hoti, kulamaccharinī hoti, lābhamaccharinī hoti, vaṇṇamaccharinī hoti, dhammamaccharinī hoti.
verses.english: She is stingy with dwellings, families, material things, praise, and the teaching.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: A nun with these five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: A nun with five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Na āvāsamaccharinī hoti, na kulamaccharinī hoti, na lābhamaccharinī hoti, na vaṇṇamaccharinī hoti, na dhammamaccharinī hoti.
verses.english: She is not stingy with dwellings, families, material things, praise, or the teaching.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatā bhikkhunī yathābhataṁ nikkhittā evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: A nun with these five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
